CRUK has a number of [bowel screening resources](https://www.cancerresearchuk.org/health-professional/cancer-screening/bowel-cancer-screening) to help you support people to make an informed decision about participating in bowel cancer screening. This includes resources for health professionals, information for the public and resources for patients.

#### Primary Care bowel cancer screening good practice guide

Cancer Research UK's [Primary Care bowel cancer screening good practice guide](https://assets.ctfassets.net/u7vsjnoopqo5/2lFie5ptESKU4gAP3GC0rv/21f3a6d84453faa4be209cc907ebdbfd/cruk_bowel_cancer_screening_good_practice_guide.pdf) (PDF) provides health professionals in primary care with practical tools and information to support their practice population to participate in bowel cancer screening through informed choice.

#### Tackling inequalities

For additional information and support addressing inequalities, read our resource [reducing inequalities in cancer screening](https://www.cancerresearchuk.org/sites/default/files/cruk_reducing_inequalities_in_cancer_screening_oct_23.pdf) (PDF) and NHS England guidance [NHS bowel cancer screening: identifying and reducing inequalities](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nhs-bowel-cancer-screening-identifying-and-reducing-inequalities/nhs-bowel-cancer-screening-identifying-and-reducing-inequalities).
